description: Replace the list of levers: the recurring kinds of goal work. At least one must be kind=hard (the work the user avoids). keywords/repos are hints for classifying sessions from their task text. wip_hashtag only for a lever whose work belongs to one product. Pass existing ids to keep them.

wip_hashtag.description: the user's WIP (wip.co) project hashtag for this work, with or without "#"; WIP todos about it carry it. Leave it out to keep the one on record; null or "" removes it
